skillFull: A latte cup appears at certain intervals. The Pet hops right in and spins around to create Milk Foam Jellies. Level Up for more points for Milk Foam Jellies.
story: "Hello there, Meowcchiato!" Everyone who wanders into the Latte Atelier always greets this adorable Milk Foam Cat first! One evening, Latte Cookie trudged home while pondering the perfect coffee-to-milk ratio—cup in hand, no time for a proper sit-down. Somehow, without noticing, a certain tiny someone had already made themselves at home in her cup! Meowcchiato loves a good nap on the windowsill. But fill a mug with warm latte, and they'll appear as if by magic, curled up and toasty before you even set it down. Plain black coffee? Not a chance! If you want to say hello to this fluffy kitty, you need to remember one question. Got milk?

costumes.name: Sunset Goggles
costumes.info: After a long day of splashing around, Meowcchiato settles in beside Latte Cookie as the evening rolls in. The goggles perched on its head reflect the warm glow of an orange sunset. As the sound of the waves washes over them and the sea breeze ruffles their soft fur... everything feels golden
